Kerala reports 10 new Shigella cases amid rising infections

Kerala has reported 10 new cases of Shigella, bringing the total number of infections to 24. The state's health department is monitoring the situation closely. This outbreak raises questions about infection control despite the region's strong healthcare infrastructure.
